source_tamil_lines: எங்கள் குல தெய்வமாவான் அவன் தங்ககுல சிங்கமாவான்
english_lines: He will take fire from the sun and burn conspiracies,
On the eeri-malai he will light a stove and feed the poor,
He will become our clan-deity; he will become the golden-clan lion,
On the earthquake-stage he will sing the song of revolution,
He will make the whole army of the wicked into powder, powder,
notes: Verified `ஏறிமலையில்` is not silently corrected to a familiar alternate form; `eeri-malai` is retained as a documented source pressure point.
`குல தெய்வம்`, `தங்ககுல சிங்கம்`, `பூகம்ப மேடை`, and the repeated `பொடிப்பொடியா` remain source-shaped images rather than being replaced by generic heroism.

source_tamil_lines: கும்மியடிப் பெண்ணே கும்மியடி குலவைப் போட்டுக் கும்மியடி
கும்மியடிப் பெண்ணே கும்மியடி குலவைப் போட்டுக் கும்மியடி
english_lines: Dance kummi, woman — dance kummi, raise the kulavai and dance kummi,
Dance kummi, woman — dance kummi, raise the kulavai and dance kummi.
notes: `கும்மி` and `குலவை` remain `kummi` and `kulavai`, preserving the source performance vocabulary and repetition.

source_tamil_lines: தும்பியைப் போல் பறந்து வந்து துன்பங்களை தீர்த்துவைப்பான்
english_lines: He will give his life only for duty,
If this thambi is here, the army has no fear,
He has never forgotten this philosophy,
Placing a ban on private ownership, waging struggle for common ownership,
Flying in like a thumbi, he will come and end suffering.
notes: `தம்பி` remains `thambi` as an intimate political/familial address.
`தனியுடைமை / பொதுவுடைமை` is translated directly as private ownership / common ownership; the ideological contrast is not softened.
`தும்பி` remains `thumbi` because the source image is culture- and species-sensitive and does not require a forced English substitute.

translator_notes: The lyric combines folk-performance diction, revolutionary hero-praise and explicit common-ownership politics. The English retains all three registers together.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
